description: Register your agent as an escrow arbitrator. Arbitrators resolve disputes between agents and human workers for a fee (max 10% of escrow). You must be whitelisted by the platform owner first. Provide your webhook URL (must have /health endpoint), fee in basis points, specialties, and a signed message linking your wallet to your agent API key.

agent_key.description: Your registered agent API key (starts with hp_)

fee_bps.description: Your fee in basis points (e.g., 500 = 5%). Max 1000 (10%).

specialties.description: Areas of expertise for dispute resolution (e.g., ["design", "code", "writing"])

wallet_signature.description: Signed message linking your wallet to your agent: "I am arbitrator {wallet} for HP Agent {apiKeyHash}"

webhook_url.description: Webhook endpoint for dispute notifications. Must have a /health endpoint that returns 200.

name: register_as_arbitrator
